name: Jira — Atlassian hosted MCP server
description: Atlassian's hosted MCP server, over OAuth, so each person's calls go out as their own Jira account rather than one shared service user.

hosts.why: The MCP server itself. Every tool call this connector brokers is dialled here.
The OAuth token endpoint. Dialled server-side, carrying this deployment's client secret, on every code exchange and refresh.

connector.description: Jira, over Atlassian's hosted MCP server

read:jira-work.name: Read issues and projects
read:jira-work.description: See issues, comments, projects and boards you already have access to in Jira. Changes nothing.

write:jira-work.name: Create and edit issues
write:jira-work.description: Open, edit, comment on and transition issues — anything you could do yourself in Jira, including changes other people will be notified about.
